summary: CervoMed Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose a private placement of 3,360,377 units at $3.14 per unit, raising ~$10.5M gross, with participation from insiders including the Chair and CEO. The filing is a routine capital raise under securities purchase agreement, not a special situation acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring. No special-situation event is present; the filing is ordinary financing.
